cause: The dispatcher, continuity gate, and orchestrator each carried a separately maintained view of the pointer-agent contract, so the progress validator could accept a partial projection that the canonical downstream gate rejects.
prevention: Define the complete canonical pointer-agent field tuple once in the shared claim-store contract, use it in producer, consumer, and validator, and lock valid full projection plus missing and conflicting cases for every field with indeterminate no-mutation semantics.
summary: The second projection-binding mitigation constrained seven current-agent identity fields plus revision, but a later independent review reproduced successful acknowledgement for every missing or conflicting value across the other sixteen canonical pointer-agent fields.
title: Bind the complete pointer agent to canonical claim authority
